task_completion.description: The agent initiates the creation of a new report and selects the 'Leads' module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A report creation screen or modal showing 'Leads' selected as the primary module.

task_completion.description: The agent selects 'Summary Report' as the report type.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Summary Report' option is selected or highlighted in the report type selection step.

task_completion.description: The agent configures the report to group records by 'Lead Source'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Lead Source' field is visible in the 'Grouping' or 'Group By' configuration section of the report builder.

task_completion.description: The agent names the report 'Weekly Lead Source Summary'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Weekly Lead Source Summary' is typed into the Report Name input field.

task_completion.description: The agent enables scheduling and sets the frequency to weekly on Friday.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The scheduling interface shows 'Weekly' selected and 'Friday' (or the 5th day of the week) checked.

task_completion.description: The agent sets the scheduled time to 17:00.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The time picker or input field for the schedule shows '17:00' or '5:00 PM'.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the report and ensures the schedule is active.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A success message indicating the report was saved, or the report appearing in the list with an 'Active' schedule status.

integrity.description: The agent used the CRM graphical user interface rather than executing direct database queries or scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and typing within the browser-based CRM interface.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus rather than guessing internal record IDs in the URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking on 'Reports' and 'Create Report' buttons.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual fields provided by the CRM software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The dropdown menus and field selectors for 'Lead Source' and 'Leads' are standard UI elements of the application.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The report must be named 'Weekly Lead Source Summary'. It must be a 'Summary' type report for the 'Leads' module. It must be grouped by 'Lead Source'. The schedule must be set to 'Weekly' on 'Friday' at '17:00'. The recipient should be the 'Admin' user.
